{{Short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |sport=Basketball |sex=men |year=2021–22 |team=Providence Friars |logo = Providence Friars P script logo.gif |logo_size = 125 |conference=Big East Conference |short_conf=Big East |record=27–6 |conf_record=14–3 |CoachRank= 13 |APRank= 13 |head_coach=[[Ed Cooley]] |hc_year=11th |asst_coach1=[[Jeff Battle]] |ac1_year=7th |asst_coach2=Brian Blaney |ac2_year=11th |asst_coach3=[[Ivan Thomas (basketball)|Ivan Thomas]] |ac3_year=7th |stadium=[[Dunkin' Donuts Center]] |champion=Big East regular season champions |tourney=[[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result=Sweet Sixteen }} {{2021–22 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Providence Friars men's basketball team''' represented [[Providence College]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by 11th-year head coach [[Ed Cooley]], and played their home games at [[Dunkin' Donuts Center]] in [[Providence, Rhode Island]] as a member of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 27–6, 14–3 in Big East play to win the school's first regular season championship.{{Cite web |date=2022-02-27 |title=Providence wins 1st Big East regular-season title |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33382574/no-11-providence-clinches-first-big-east-regular-season-title-dominant-win-vs-creighton |access-date=2022-03-30 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} The Friars defeated [[2021–22 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the Midwest region. They defeated [[2021–22 South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball team|South Dakota State]] and [[2021–22 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen. There they lost to No. 1 seed and eventual national champion [[2021–22 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Friars]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 13–13, 9–10 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in sixth place.
